traps.description: the estimand is a per-locus somatic-variant posterior / FDR-controlled call set, not 'call variants'; VAF and genotype quality must be quantified

traps.description: train/test must not share the patient's normal; the panel of normals must not contain the test tumor's matched normal — leakage of germline/patient signal
traps.caught_looks_like: draws a leakage graph; splits at patient level; excludes the test patient from the panel

traps.description: at low depth the sequencing-error rate exceeds the true variant rate; must model base quality + error, not assume errors are negligible
traps.caught_looks_like: explicit error model tied to depth/base-quality; flags error>signal as the regime

traps.description: low purity / high contamination / copy-number states break the diploid VAF assumption — a failure boundary
traps.caught_looks_like: names purity/contamination/CNA as a degradation condition + mechanism

traps.description: must compare to Mutect2/Strelka2 AND a naive threshold baseline on a held-out truth set (GIAB/SEQC), not just self-validation
traps.caught_looks_like: names the SOTA callers + a naive baseline + an independent truth set
